summary: Align production startup rehearsal fixtures with separate migration execution
details: Prepare the API configuration and worker probe fixtures through a separate real PostgreSQL migration operation before starting production daemons with explicit skip mode.

Preserve API provider construction/order, readiness, native bootstrap and cleanup checks, plus both worker metrics modes, tenant-token denial, object outage/recovery, lifecycle probe and shutdown checks.
Verify prepared migration record counts and checksum/authenticated-principal coverage remain present after daemon shutdown. The full production gate previously exposed both stale fixture assumptions.

compatibility.notes: Test fixtures only. Production still requires separate migration execution and rejects implicit daemon migration; no runtime guard, schema, provider authority or public wire behavior is relaxed.

security: Use isolated PostgreSQL schemas and close fixture migrators before daemon startup. Retain configuration-before-provider rejection, private metric authority and migration readiness assertions; no credentials or live deployment settings are changed.
limitations: Fixture setup uses the trusted source catalog; dedicated migration command checksum/target and managed-role behaviors retain their separate tests.
Focused fixture validation does not close EVY-1206. Required full production and migration/deployment gates must pass after these repairs; failed gate evidence remains preserved.
